# githubsettings_repository_immutable_releases (Resource)

Manages immutable releases for one repository. Creating or updating this resource applies the configured policy to GitHub; destroying it removes the resource from Terraform state without changing the policy. GitHub can enforce immutable releases through the repository owner. enforced_by_owner reports that policy and the provider rejects changes while it is active. Requires a token with repository administration write access.

Removing this resource from Terraform management leaves the GitHub setting in place.

## Import the current setting

Add the import block below to a Terraform project configured with `elephant-evergreen/githubsettings`. The [quickstart](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/githubsettings/latest/docs#import-a-policy) shows the provider block and initialization. Replace the example ID and address with those of your resource.

```terraform
import {
  to = githubsettings_repository_immutable_releases.example
  id = "example-owner/example-repository"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with arguments that match the current GitHub values.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan` and keep a plan that contains only the import. If it proposes a change, compare the differing values with the current policy and save a new plan.
3. Apply the saved plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_repository_immutable_releases" "example" {
  owner      = "example-owner"
  repository = "example-repository"
  enabled    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable immutable releases.
- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.
- `repository` (String) GitHub repository name within the owner account.

### Read-Only

- `enforced_by_owner` (Boolean) Whether the repository owner enforces immutable releases. The provider rejects changes while this is true.
